oh its just going back and forth. it isnt fixed. its because i went to coarse detail after reloading and that changes the paint layout entirely
resolution: Fixed two root-cause paint bugs in the Studio model painter. req_1318: the detail slider doubled as the storage grid size, so changing it re-keyed every stored cell against a different-sized grid (paint scrambled / half-vanished / couldn't reach the end of big faces). Paint now stores on a FIXED grid (PAINT_GRID_UNITS in meshPaint.tsx); the slider only sizes the brush dab via the new dabRadiusCells helper, and faceCellGrid coarsens the cell when a face would exceed GRID_MAX so the grid always spans the whole face (no dropped tail). Overlay + bake routed through the fixed grid. Tests meshPaint 10/10.
